title: 第25章 人命关天第26章 震惊全场
slug: 赵老驴和杏花村的女人们
content_zh:
“为什么这么说？”赵大柱问道。
王彩霞说道：“我也是听人说的，刘老头的血栓一次比一次严重，而且县城医院治不好，要去市里的大医院才有可能治好，可他没钱，只能拖着……所以我觉得他这次恐怕真的不行了。”
忽然意识到什么，王彩霞又补充道：“我可不是在咒他，我只是觉得他现在病情严重……”
“行了你别说了。”赵大柱赶忙打断。
在院门口围观的村民数量特别多，有几十个呢。
但是没有一个人敢进去查看情况，毕竟刘老头生死不明，谁都不想扯上关系。
万一有人过去，刘老头刚好咽气，那就说不清是谁的责任了。
等了没多长时间，贾慧珍这个女村医就提着一只医药箱急匆匆的来了。
也不知道是谁喊了一声贾大夫来了把路让开，拥挤在院门口的村民便朝着两侧后退，让出中间这条道儿。
身着白大褂，胸口还带着听诊器的贾慧珍，于是就提着医药箱快步进了院子，一路小跑的来到刘老头面前蹲下。
只见贾慧珍左右开弓，一只手拿着听诊器为刘老头听诊，另一只手则搭在刘老头的手腕上为他把脉。
院门口的村民们停止议论，不敢大声说话，生怕吵到人家。
但随着时间的推移，贾慧珍脸上的表情还是变得难看起来。
一个浓眉大眼的小伙子实在忍不住了，大着胆子问道：“贾大夫，刘老头情况咋样？还活着吗？”
这个小伙子算是问出了大家伙的心声，所有人都眼巴巴的看着贾慧珍，等她给出答复。
贾慧珍有些着急的说道：“刘老头还活着，但是只剩下一口气了。他的病情很严重，我治不了，得赶紧叫救护车！”
“什么？贾大夫你医术那么好，你居然治不了？”那个小伙子又说道。
贾慧珍恼怒的说道：“我医术好顶什么用，这里要啥没啥，我光靠两只手能把他治好就见鬼了！”
贾慧珍的话非常在理，院门口的村民都纷纷点头。
但是没有一个人掏出手机叫救护车。

倒不是他们不愿意帮忙，主要是叫来救护车，费用谁来掏？
杏花村只不过是一个穷乡僻壤的小村子，除了王建国这个狗村长富得流油，其他人基本上都穷的叮当响。
叫救护车的钱，在他们眼里自然不是一笔小钱。
贾慧珍见那么多村民没有一个愿意打电话，于是她只能掏出自己的手机准备叫救护车。
可就在这时，人群里忽然传来一声大喊：“等等，让我试试！”
贾慧珍微微一愣，紧接着她就看到一个身影从人群里挤了出来——正是赵大柱！
不只是贾慧珍这个女村医感到惊讶，院门口那么多村民也都惊讶的不得了，尤其是王彩霞。
“不是，赵老头你逞什么能，治病救人可不是力气大就行，你不能胡来啊！”王彩霞急急忙忙的说道。
“是啊赵老头，没有那个金刚钻就别揽这个瓷器活。”
“万一你没把人救活，反而把人治死了，那你的麻烦可就大了！”
“刘老头是有儿子的，他儿子在县城打工，如果刘老头没了，他儿子一定回来找你拼命！”
“赵大柱你冷静点！”
content_en:
"Why do you say that?" Zhao Dazhu asked.
Wang Caixia said: "I have also heard from people that Old Man Liu's blood clots are getting more serious each time, and the county hospital cannot cure it. Only by going to a large hospital in the city can he be cured. But he has no money, so he can only delay...so I think he may really not survive this time."
Suddenly realizing something, Wang Caixia added: "I'm not cursing him, I just think he is seriously ill now..."
"Okay, stop talking." Zhao Dazhu quickly interrupted.
There were a large number of villagers watching at the entrance of the courtyard, dozens of them.
But no one dared to go in to check the situation. After all, Old Man Liu's life and death were unknown, and no one wanted to get involved.
If someone passes by and Old Liu dies, it’s unclear who is responsible.
Not long after waiting, Jia Huizhen, a female village doctor, hurried over carrying a medical kit.
I don't know who called out to Dr. Jia to get out of the way. The villagers crowded at the entrance of the courtyard retreated to both sides to make way for the middle road.
Jia Huizhen, who was wearing a white coat and a stethoscope on her chest, quickly walked into the yard carrying the medical kit, trotted all the way to Old Man Liu and squatted down in front of him.
Jia Huizhen was seen holding a stethoscope in one hand to auscultate Old Man Liu, while the other hand was placed on Old Man Liu's wrist to feel his pulse.
The villagers at the entrance of the courtyard stopped talking and did not dare to speak loudly for fear of disturbing others.
But as time went by, the expression on Jia Huizhen's face still became ugly.
A young man with thick eyebrows and big eyes couldn't bear it anymore and boldly asked: "Doctor Jia, how is old man Liu? Is he still alive?"
This young man finally asked what everyone was thinking. Everyone looked at Jia Huizhen eagerly, waiting for her answer.
Jia Huizhen said anxiously: "Old Liu is still alive, but he only has one breath left. His condition is very serious and I can't cure it. I have to call an ambulance quickly!"
"What? Doctor Jia, your medical skills are so good, but you can't cure me?" the young man said again.
Jia Huizhen said angrily: "My medical skills are of no use. It doesn't matter what you want here. Damn it if I can cure him with just two hands!"
Jia Huizhen's words were very reasonable, and the villagers at the entrance of the courtyard all nodded.
But no one took out their mobile phones and called an ambulance.
It's not that they are unwilling to help, the main thing is to call an ambulance. Who will pay for it?
Xinghua Village is just a small village in a remote area. Except for Wang Jianguo, the dog village leader who is extremely rich, everyone else is basically poor.
The money to call an ambulance is naturally not a small amount of money in their eyes.
Jia Huizhen saw that none of the villagers were willing to call, so she could only take out her mobile phone and prepare to call an ambulance.
But at this moment, a shout suddenly came from the crowd: "Wait, let me try!"
Jia Huizhen was stunned for a moment, and then she saw a figure squeeze out of the crowd - it was Zhao Dazhu!
Not only Jia Huizhen, the female village doctor, was surprised, but so many villagers at the entrance of the hospital were also surprised, especially Wang Caixia.
"No, old man Zhao, what are you trying to do? Healing diseases and saving people requires more than just strength. You can't do whatever you want!" Wang Caixia said hurriedly.
"Yes, Old Man Zhao, don't take this porcelain job without that diamond."
"If you don't save people, but kill them instead, you'll be in big trouble!"
"Old man Liu has a son, and his son is working in the county. If old man Liu dies, his son will definitely come back and fight for you!"
"Zhao Dazhu, calm down!"
